name: Summarize text (AI)
description: Example workflow 1. Summarizes the text given as input. Needs AI_PROVIDER, its API key and AI_MODEL in backend/.env.

input.text: Forge-fort is a visual workflow builder. Users drag nodes onto a canvas, connect them, and run the workflow on a Node.js backend. The engine orders nodes with Kahn's algorithm, runs them one at a time, and decides which branches run with an edge-state model. HTTP requests are protected against SSRF, AI calls go through Gemini or OpenAI, and every node can retry transient failures with exponential backoff.

config.instructions: Summarize in two short sentences for a non-technical reader.
